anchor_value: EUR 13,809 local par requiring USD principal conversion

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Pluto Holdco Limited | First Lien Secured Debt - Term Loan | 5.96 % PIK | 6/5/2026 | EUR | 13,809 | 14,978 | 16,188 | (3)(4)(8)(9)(10)(20)

findings.detail: Non-USD debt par is present in source as EUR 13,809, but the extracted principal_amount_usd field is blank.

rationale: FX01 is a within-row missing-normalized-principal issue: the flagged field principal_amount_usd is blank while the raw SOI row shows a euro-denominated debt par amount. Because non-USD debt par requires an explicit USD principal conversion before par analytics, the blank normalized USD principal is a real data error rather than a false alarm.
